seo.defaultDescription: Explore SpiritVale builds, classes, equipment, and verified game data.

site.name: SpiritVale Lab
site.dataNotice: Game data is extracted locally for research and guide use

common.unknown: Not available in verified game data

home.seoDescription: Browse SpiritVale classes, skills, equipment, and community builds, then create and share your own.
home.heroLine1: Explore classes, skills, and equipment organized from game data,
home.heroLine2: then create and share your own build with real game entries.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search community builds, classes, or tags…
home.databaseDescription: Every count comes directly from local game resources loaded by the current API. No demo entries are used as filler.
home.rankingDescription: Only builds actually published by players appear here. Likes and unique views determine ranking; there are no sample cards.
home.emptyBuildsDescription: The build library now starts from clean, real data. A build appears here only after a player publishes it.
home.noMatchingBuildsDescription: Try another term or clear the search to see all real builds.
home.plannerTitle: Turn game data into your next build
home.plannerDescription: Choose a class, skills, and equipment, add your gameplay notes, and publish to the build library.

builds.seoDescription: Find and share practical SpiritVale builds by keyword and class.
builds.title: Build Library
builds.subtitle: Find ready-to-play builds by keyword and class.
builds.rankExplanation: Score = likes × 5 + unique views. Likes carry more weight, and repeat opens from the same browser count as one view.
builds.emptyDescription: This site does not fill the list with sample builds. Create and publish the first build based on real gameplay.
builds.noResultsDescription: Try clearing the keyword or class filter.
builds.engagementPrivacy: Engagement uses an anonymous browser identifier; the server stores only its hash.
builds.engagementUnavailable: Engagement is temporarily unavailable. You can still read this build.

classes.seoDescription: Browse SpiritVale base-to-advanced class relationships, roles, skills, and community builds.
classes.title: Class Database
classes.subtitle: Browse base, advanced, special, and profession classes through the native game progression table, then inspect source-backed skills and community builds.
classes.lineageSource: Read from Formula.GetRequiredClass in the installed GameAssembly.dll
classes.specialLineageNote: Weaver is outside this required-base mapping; professions and service classes are not combat advancement paths. Native enum entries without a current ArchetypeConfig are explicitly marked.
classes.noResultsHint: Try another keyword or clear the class role filter.
classes.descriptionMissing: No class description is available in verified game data.
classes.notFoundHint: It may not be indexed from local game data yet, or the link may be outdated.
classes.createWithClass: Create a build with this class
classes.skillDescriptionMissing: No skill description is available in verified game data.
classes.skillsMissing: No skill associations are available for this class.
classes.previewSkillsDescription: Only relationships explicitly stored in ArchetypeConfig.PreviewSkills are shown. This is not a complete class skill list.
classes.previewSkillsMissing: No preview skills are stored for this class in the source configuration.
classes.buildReferencedSkillsDescription: These skills come from public community builds. They show usage on this site, not class ownership.
classes.buildReferencedSkillsMissing: Current public builds do not add any skill references.
classes.chooseAdvancedAt: At job level {level}, this base class can enter these native advancement paths:
classes.specialProgression: This class has no fixed base class in the native GetRequiredClass mapping, so it is not forced into an invented path.
classes.professionProgression: This is a profession or service class and is outside the combat base-to-advanced mapping.
classes.noProgression: The native mapping does not record an advancement relationship for this class.
classes.configNotPresent: Native enum exists · current config absent
classes.attributesMissing: No attribute array is available in verified game data.
classes.attributesOrderUnknown: The source declares six integer positions without verified index names, so the original order is preserved.
classes.equipmentMissing: No class-restricted equipment is recorded for this class.
classes.noBuilds: No public builds are available for this class yet.

equipment.seoDescription: Search and filter SpiritVale equipment, including verified slots, types, affixes, sets, and related builds.
equipment.title: Equipment Database
equipment.subtitle: Search names, descriptions, and affixes, then narrow results by class, slot, type, element, required level, or set. Only verified local game data is shown.
equipment.searchPlaceholder: Search equipment names, descriptions, or affixes…
equipment.apiUnavailable: The equipment API is not enabled.
equipment.loadErrorHint: Please try again later. Your selected filters will be kept.
equipment.noResultsHint: Try fewer filters or another name, description, or affix keyword.
equipment.descriptionMissing: No equipment description is available in verified game data.
equipment.detailDescriptionMissing: No description is available for this item in verified game data.
equipment.factsMissing: Type, element, and level are not available
equipment.notFoundHint: It may not be indexed from local game data yet, or the link may be outdated.
equipment.evidenceDescription: Distinguishes source fields from mappings generated for browsing.
equipment.runtimeSlotsHint: Slots is preserved as a raw numeric EquipConfig field. Its meaning is unverified and it must not be treated as a wear location.
equipment.primaryMissing: Primary stats are not available in verified game data.
equipment.secondaryMissing: Secondary stats are not available in verified game data.
equipment.affixesMissing: The affix pool is not available in verified game data.
equipment.availableAffixesMissing: The affix pool does not provide any available affixes.
equipment.setBonusesMissing: Set bonuses are not available in verified game data.
equipment.setMissing: Set membership and bonuses are not available in verified game data.
equipment.classRestrictionsMissing: Class restrictions are not available in verified game data.
equipment.allClassesAllowedDetail: The source explicitly has no class restriction: every class can use this item.
equipment.noRelatedBuilds: No public builds currently include this item.
